purpose: simpler painterly slot symbols with isolated transparent cells

prompts.bonanza:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production raster slot symbol atlas, transparent PNG, 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve individually isolated symbols in row-major order.
Input image role: subject/order reference only. Completely redraw the art in the style below; remove the reference's over-rendering, filigree, halos and glitter.
Primary request: distinctive, convincingly drawn game art with strong designed silhouettes, subtle brush edges and simple broad shading. NOT a vector sheet, NOT glossy 3D renders, NOT photoreal object photos.
Technical composition: landscape 4:3 canvas. Twelve identical square invisible cells. Each object centered in its OWN cell and fits within the CENTRAL 66% of that cell on BOTH axes. At least 17% completely transparent padding on every side of each cell; no object may cross a grid boundary. All 12 complete objects, no cut parts, no adjacent fragments. No grid lines, labels, text, watermarks, backgrounds, decorative particles or baked drop shadows.
Drawing: controlled dark contour, 3-4 broad painted tones per material, one consistent light from upper left, one restrained highlight, readable at 64 pixels. Fine natural brush texture only inside broad painted areas. Deliberate small asymmetry for character. No ambient glow, gold halo, gems on ordinary objects, intricate generic ornaments or pseudo writing.
Art direction: cheerful 2D candy-and-fruit arcade illustration; rounded bold silhouettes and saturated blue/leaf green/plum/red, natural warm yellow. Soft candy surfaces have a short broad satin highlight, NOT sugary glitter, crystal facets or gold edges. Fruits feel cartoon-painted, no photoreal skin microtexture. Anonymous mask appears ONLY in special mask scatter.
Exact order:
row1: 0 blue oval chewy candy; 1 green rounded pentagonal jelly candy with smooth soft edges; 2 purple square pillow candy; 3 red heart chewy candy.
row2: 4 small bunch of three curved bananas; 5 one purple plum with one green leaf; 6 one red apple with one simple leaf; 7 small watermelon with a single bright red slice.
row3: 8 a compact bunch of about twelve purple grapes with one leaf; 9 a green fabric hood containing a clearly recognizable warm ivory Anonymous/Guy Fawkes mask, dark eyebrows/eyes/curling moustache/goatee; 10 two crossed bananas on a SIMPLE round green painted badge, no ornate frame; 11 pink spiral wrapped candy with two small plain gold beads, no multiplier text.
Emphasis: all subjects simplified compared with reference but still finished raster painted game art, not flat vector icons.
